title: Talon Lake Campground and Marina

services.name: Cottage Rental
services.desc: At Talon Lake Campground and Marina, we have 1 two bedroom cottage in our campground and one 4 bedroom cottage at a different location on Talon Lake, which is only accessible by taking a 5 minute boat ride. In our campground, our 2 two bedroom housekeeping cottage has a fridge with a freezer compartment, stove, microwave, coffeepot, toaster, kettle, pots and pans, dishes, cutlery, barb-q, color TV with satellite TV, and a screened in porch. It has a picnic table and their own campfire pit. It has hot and cold running water, showers and flush toilets. When available, free use of canoes and kayaks.
